num_8.title: Integer Division
num_8.prompt: What does the // operator do in Python?
num_8.explanation: // is integer division! It divides and only keeps the whole part of the number, discarding whatever comes after the decimal point. 7 // 2 = 3 (not 3.5)! ✂️
